evidence: Independent source-exposed broad-assembly explicit witness; not player evidence, goal-insensitive proof, optimum or fun finding.

goals.title: Bright protected garden
goals.requirement: At bed, an actual rootbed is enclosed, illuminated and receiving clean water in the day row. Any construction satisfying those properties works.

goals.title: First signal
goals.requirement: The northern receiver has actually received the bed location through an optical event, and the bed garden is currently functioning. Both goals may complete together.

goals.title: Still and growing place
goals.requirement: At bed, an actual enclosed illuminated rootbed receives clean water originating at one of this map’s real source places. Keep a dry walk from walk-start to walk-end. The clean source is a legal alternative to purification.

goals.title: Drying and preservation
goals.requirement: A support carrying bright-specimen at table is dry, illuminated and air-exposed; a different support carrying dark-specimen at alcove is dark and protected. The actual records/site tags remain separate.

goals.title: Two skies
goals.requirement: One actual rootbed at bed is enclosed, clean-water-fed and illuminated in both opposing sky rows. Static dual sources, actual reflected light or any other legal assembly may work; no controller is prescribed.

goals.title: Two viewpoints
goals.requirement: At alcove, actual records of spire observed from west-view and east-view are inside actual dust-protected containment. The place itself supplies darkness, not a covering; a supported mesh screen is a valid dust cover and need not be sealed. A single camera moved between views is valid. Copies of an unobserving camera do not acquire either record.

goals.title: Carry the existing garden
goals.requirement: The actual initial garden object from start reaches destination with its living rootbed identity retained and its enclosure, illumination and clean-water supply functioning. A fresh copy at destination is not movement of that garden.

goals.title: Deploy then recover
goals.requirement: A mobile assembly has actually supplied a span across gap-west–gap-east and, AFTER actually spanning, traveled through low-west plus low-east or lower-west plus lower-east, and now stands at gap-east or destination while a real usable gap crossing remains. Leaving another physical span copy is legal; an absent span cannot support the gap.

goals.title: Warm place, protected sample
goals.requirement: At warm-room, an actual tray or recording support is enclosed, protected and warmed; a distinct sample support at sample-alcove is dark and protected, and an enclosed illuminated clean-water-fed rootbed grows at bed in every listed row.

goals.title: Usable window
goals.requirement: Actual tray or recording supports inside enclosures at warm-room and cool-room are protected in both dust rows; an actual instrument retained at window has recorded the visible valley-marker in a clear row; a distinct dark, dust-protected sample support at sample-alcove has actually acquired valley-sample from specimen-site.

goals.title: Distinguishable messages
goals.requirement: Receiver actually obtains the A-original and B-original records, while their original recording objects remain protected at original-a and original-b respectively. Keep a traversable return route from junction to dock. Fresh design copies do not carry historical records.

goals.title: Recover the stranded instrument
goals.requirement: The actual initial stranded-camera, retaining its expedition record and identity, reaches dock and delivers that record to the receiver. Both original source objects remain protected at their own places. Modifying the camera into a vehicle is legal.

goals.title: A window that supports and shows
goals.requirement: Lifecycle achievement: at survey-window, the actual initial survey-camera’s own lens has recorded beacon from that viewpoint through the same local rigid, clear, watertight surface that has the displayed closed north/south profile and actively encloses that initial instrument’s own lens and record plate. A rigid frame elsewhere plus a flexible film does not make one rigid clear surface. This achievement remains earned when that same camera later moves.

conditions.label: actual initial camera made the beacon observation through this rigid clear supporting boundary

goals.title: Soft light, real growth
goals.requirement: Current service: a rootbed at shade-bed is growing, with one actual diffuse watertight boundary actively enclosing the same illuminated tray and seed that are growing. Diffuse light grows this bed but is not a faithful camera view. A diffuser merely attached outside an unchanged enclosure does not satisfy the boundary requirement.

conditions.label: growing bed has a real diffuse enclosing surface

goals.title: Turn daylight toward the bed
goals.requirement: Current service: an exposed reflecting surface at mirror-perch actively supplies an actual light interface to shade-bed in the day row, and that bed grows. A powered lamp remains useful but cannot make an unlit decorative reflector count as the reflecting source. Flexible foil and a rigid reflecting surface are both eligible.

conditions.label: a genuinely lit reflecting surface supplies the perch-to-bed interface
the destination bed actually grows

goals.title: Carry the observed instrument into the wet
goals.requirement: Current service: the actual initial survey-camera reaches wet-station retaining its real beacon observation from survey-window. A local flexible watertight boundary now actively encloses that initial instrument’s own lens and record plate. A reusable clear-film shell is a valid answer; no transformation is required merely to rename an adequate wrap.

conditions.label: same observed camera is flexibly enclosed at the wet station

goals.title: Try a real impression while it is soft
goals.requirement: Lifecycle achievement: the actual original-clay carrier is at opening with a moldable surface that took this actual opening’s impression and was fitted there while moldable. The exact displayed opening, contact edges and face must match. A copied blank design has shape but no impression or fit event.

conditions.label: one moldable impressed surface was actually fitted to opening

goals.title: Keep the impression, change its material
goals.requirement: Lifecycle achievement: the actual original-clay carrier reaches drain with one rigid, porous, durable surface still carrying the opening impression and that same surface’s earlier moldable fit. Heat provenance is not retained heater power. This earned stage may later be followed by returning the actual formed carrier.

conditions.label: same previously fitted surface is now rigid porous and durable at drain

goals.title: An open contact and a lined contact
goals.requirement: Current pair: drain has a rigid porous surface actually fitted to its open profile; basin has a distinct rigid watertight surface actually fitted to the same geometric profile. Lining changes passage through the surface, not its stored shape. A copied blank form is valid at either site; the original impression need not be duplicated.

conditions.label: drain retains a fitted rigid porous surface
basin has a fitted rigid watertight surface

goals.title: Keep the profile, return the master
goals.requirement: Current pair: paper-slot has a flexible porous temporary recording surface fitted to its closed east/west, north-facing profile, and the actual initial mesh-master has been moved from casting-bay to tool-rack. Saved matching sheet designs may be copied; this job does not falsely require every copy to witness the master.

conditions.label: a shaped recording sheet fits the different paper slot
the actual master tool is back on its rack

goals.title: Bring the worked original home
goals.requirement: Current arrival: the actual original-clay carrier is at collection with a rigid durable surface retaining its actual opening impression and earlier moldable fit. Its recorded route includes drain, low-mouth and low-exit. A copied replacement may keep the drain service operating while the worked original returns. Copying a design does not fabricate this trip.

conditions.label: actual worked form returned through the low collection route

goals.title: Show a copy without exposing its original
goals.requirement: Current pair: wet-exhibit has an illuminated durable watertight recording surface bearing a genuine physical copy of survey-A from archive-a. The actual archive-a remains at vault-a, dark and dust-protected by an actual assembly. Its place name supplies no automatic covering.

conditions.label: illuminated wet display holds a durable physical copy of A
the actual A original stays dark and protected at its own site

goals.title: Keep another copy open for contact
goals.requirement: Current complement: press holds an exposed, dry, porous temporary recording surface with a separate genuine copy of survey-A from archive-a. The wet-display copy remains a different physical surface at another place. Waterproofing every copy is not the same result as preserving an open contact surface.

conditions.label: an actual A copy stays exposed porous and dry for contact

goals.title: Two originals, one receiver
goals.requirement: Current record service: receiver has the genuine survey-A and survey-B record IDs, and both actual originals remain dust-protected at vault-a and vault-b. You may relay optically, relay through a real physical copy, or combine those methods; no prescribed intermediate catalogue name is checked.

conditions.label: receiver holds actual A
conditions.subject: survey-A

conditions.label: receiver holds actual B
conditions.subject: survey-B

conditions.label: A original remains protected at its own site
B original remains protected at its own site

goals.title: Carry an impression through two changes
goals.requirement: Current display: relief-display holds one rigid, durable, watertight surface with the actual relief impression and that same surface’s earlier moldable fit at relief. Its closed east/south, north-facing profile survives. This is physical impression history, not an optical observation or a blank design’s shape.

conditions.label: real soft-fitted relief survives as a rigid watertight durable surface

goals.title: A formerly blank support becomes an archive
goals.requirement: Current arrival: the actual initially blank-support reaches registry as a usable tray-and-recording support carrying survey-B acquired by a real event. Its earlier structural role does not grant any record automatically. The original B need not move and its copied design remains blank.

conditions.label: the actual originally blank support now carries B at registry

goals.title: Wet growth beside dry specimen work
goals.requirement: Current services in both opposing rows: an actual dirty-spring→filter-pad→bed water route supplies a growing bed, and a porous surface at filter-pad actively supplies its outgoing water interface. At table a distinct site-tagged specimen support is dry, lit and air-exposed. A familiar tube-and-mesh filter remains valid; a new porous form is another eligible local surface.

conditions.label: real dirty source supplies the filter
a porous active interface supplies the growing place
the supplied nursery grows in both rows
a distinct real specimen dries on the table

goals.title: One real nursery, also an observatory
goals.requirement: Current integrated service: the actual initial nursery reaches bed and is both growing and an actual camera, with a real lookout observation made from bed through the same currently selected local rigid clear watertight boundary. That boundary actively encloses its original growing tray and seed and a faithful working lens. An opaque support elsewhere or an exterior decorative clear panel does not satisfy this joint boundary.

conditions.label: the moved nursery grows and made its observation through this actual rigid clear boundary

goals.title: Bring home a worked form and a real record
goals.requirement: Current arrival: one carrier at arrival contains a rigid durable surface with the actual opening impression and its earlier moldable fit, plus the genuine expedition-original record. That carrier’s route includes low-west and low-east. A fresh prefab may reproduce its geometry but cannot reproduce either the impression or the acquired record.

conditions.label: a worked form and acquired historical record returned together through the low passage

goals.title: Send the new view without moving the old original
goals.requirement: Current record service: receiver retains the actual expedition-original and actual lookout observation, while the original-survey object remains dust-protected at source with its own record. Direct light, reflected light, real copies and retained assemblies are all allowed where their stated interface conditions hold.

conditions.label: receiver holds the historical expedition record
